judges: The High Court Of Tripura J.
case_name: Shri Mouli Bhusan Bhattacharjee vs Dead on 30 May, 2017

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shri Mouli Bhusan Bhattacharjee (son and plaintiff-appellant)
parties.respondent_defendant: Dead (intestate) / Shri Swarup Bhattacharjee, Shri Snehamoy Bhattacharjee, Shri Subhrangshu Sekhar Bhattacharjee, Shri Snehangshu Sekhar Bhattacharjee, Shri Subhankar Bhattacharjee, Smt. Jayankari Bhattacharjee, Shri Mrinmoy Chakraborty (defendant-respondents)

facts_of_case: The late Bidhu Bushan Bhattacharjee died intestate on 26-4-1949, survived by his son Mouli Bhusan Bhattacharjee and others. The plaintiff-appellant claimed a preliminary decree for partitioning the suit land.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking partition to establish that the property is joint and that the proposed partition is reasonable.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that in a partition suit, the burden lies on the party seeking partition to establish that the property is joint and that the proposed partition is reasonable.

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant liberty to pray for a final decree if the decretal land is not partitioned within a specified time.
legal_principles.held: The trial court also gave liberty to pray for a final decree to enforce the preliminary decree if the decretal land was not partitioned within six months.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Section X

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the judgment dated 13-6-2011 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division) is set aside.
